decisions.decision: Commit 8af25074 (2026-10-16) adds the values to the day packs, but the task has no evidence attached. Do the following on a private local stack with simulator writes only. (1) Fill the centre as Tantra: tick some start-domains suggestions and type one own domain. Then export and show dom_picked and dom_own in context/answers.json. If they only appear in the state block, also write them to answers.json. (2) Show google_sa_email and domain_proof (_revops-proof) in answers.json, and ga4.measurement_id in CentreState. (3) Rerun D0.13 and D0.35 in the T-461 harness, in fresh sessions. Both must pass without asking for these values. Never weaken an assertion. Attach to the task the file excerpts, the harness run IDs or logs, and the commit hash. Push any fix to main. Then leave the task in review for Adi.
